section_summary: This section contains correspondence, permit applications, action slips, and policy circulars regarding foreign travel to occupied Japan between February and March 1949. It documents procedures for commercial representatives, missionaries, and technical consultants seeking military entry clearances through the Department of Commerce, the Department of State, and SCAP. It also details the newly established February 10, 1949 program authorizing sixty-day compassionate visits with immediate relatives in Japan, as well as diplomatic routing for applicants from nations represented by protecting powers.
